title: PPD shut down and possibly reborn as other programs

tellings.quote: I'm I'm pretty sure that PBD has been shut down.

plain: The program Dan Sherman says he worked in, which he calls PPD and describes as an NSA effort to talk with aliens, has been shut down and may have been reborn as other programs. Sherman, a former sergeant who says he took part in it in the early 1990s, tells Michels "I'm pretty sure" it was shut down, and names a Scott Andrews in telling it. If true, the work would have carried on under other names.
